name: Hugging Face hf-mount
description: Installs the hf-mount daemon and its NFS and FUSE backends from upstream release binaries, to mount Hugging Face Buckets and repositories as local filesystems.

version.description: The upstream release to install: latest, or a release number of the form MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH without a leading v.

backend.description: The backends installed next to the daemon, which is always installed: hf-mount-nfs, hf-mount-fuse, or both.

installMountDependencies.description: Install the mount helpers of the selected backends: nfs-common or nfs-utils for NFS, fuse3 for FUSE.
